title: Futex Linux-compat stabilization and merge readiness
summary: Move the futex Linux-compat worktree from implemented slices to a merge-ready module candidate by making guest PI-condvar evidence rerunnable, cleaning stale caveats, and running focused host/guest gates.

write_sets.notes: Single-agent stabilization slice in codex/futex-linux-compat; do not edit /Users/3y/Downloads/Tx.

steps.title: Promote PI-condvar guest helper to a named entrypoint
steps.notes: Added a Makefile target that rebuilds the private RV64 submit kernel, runs the existing helper with explicit private source/working image paths, and keeps official OSComp images untouched.

steps.title: Clean stale futex deferred comments
verification: rg -n "PI selectors remain partial|futex2 wake/wait/requeue syscalls remain explicitly deferred|WAIT_REQUEUE_PI.*unimplemented|CMP_REQUEUE_PI.*unimplemented" crates/tx-shims/src/linux_syscall docs/progress/research/2026-05-26-futex-pi-requeue-priority-boost-readiness.md
steps.notes: Updated shim docs and the PI readiness note so completed PI/futex2 surfaces are not described as deferred.

steps.title: Run focused host and guest gates
steps.notes: Focused host gates passed. Guest PI-condvar target produced PASS pthread-pi-condvar, wrapper return 0, userspace:exited:0, and no fault-decode trap lines in target/oscomp/os_serial_out_pthread_pi_condvar_stabilize_20260527.txt. Focused libctest pthread condvar/robust and cancel slices passed with userspace:exited:0.

steps.title: Run final merge-readiness gates and progress catch-up
steps.notes: Final gates passed after the progress catch-up: cargo fmt --check, cargo -q xtask unit, cargo xtask progress validate, and git diff --check.
